skipped: the race was suspended — a lap of 862s was run with the cars stationary, and no term in this model describes a red flag
source: fitted to Jolpica-F1 2026 round 7 lap times and stints
limitations: Parameters are fitted to this race and nothing else. They describe the car, tyres and track as they were on the day, and carry no claim about any other round.
Fuel burn and track evolution are both linear in lap number and cannot be told apart from one race, so the whole coefficient is published as fuel and the evolution rate is zero rather than guessed.
Pit loss, the standing-start loss and the cost of a neutralised lap are measured against the fit, not fitted as free parameters.
A stint starting on used tyres is modelled as starting on fresh ones: the source publishes the age but this model has no term for it, so the compound's offset absorbs the average.

Only drivers whose replayed real strategy reproduces their real race time within 1% are offered as a what-if. The rest are listed with the error, because a model that cannot reproduce what happened has no standing to say what would have.
